description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 5 October 2018, the third of the enhanced packs built around particular types, here Lightning, Darkness and Metal. Incineroar-GX, whose Ability attaches three Darkness Energy at the cost of 30 damage to itself, and Hoopa-GX, which can take any two cards from the deck, lead it, with Ampharos-GX, Cobalion-GX, and Prism Star Tapu Koko and Black Market. The cards are numbered to 52, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Nanu and Jasmine, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Electrocharger, Dangerous Drill and Metal Goggles. In English most of its cards came out in Team Up in February 2019.
